blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House prosecution panel member and Manila Rep. Joel Chua on Saturday likened the impeachment conviction of former Chief Justice Renato Corona over undisclosed assets to the unexplained wealth allegations against Vice President Sara Duterte, which a prosecution expert estimated could amount to P1.5 billion.
